subject: CMenuManager state machine — menu system globals and page/panel layout
overview: CMenuManager handles all in-game menus (pause menu, map screen, stat screens, save/load) as a state machine. The current page is tracked by a page ID enum; each page renders a fixed-layout set of rows using CFont and CSprite2d. The debug menu is guarded by gbActualVersion at 0xBA6748 (set to 1 in retail builds, disabling all developer pages).

CMenuManager_m_nCurrentMenuPage.description: Active menu page ID. Changing this at runtime switches the displayed page. Value 0 = no menu / game running.

gbActualVersion.description: Guard flag: 1 = retail build (all debug pages disabled), 0 = debug build (developer menu accessible). Always 1 in the retail exe. Setting to 0 at runtime restores the debug menu.
gbActualVersion.note: Confirmed from the guard check at the debug menu entry: `CMP [0xBA6748], 0; JNZ skip_debug_menu`

CMenuManager_m_bMenuActive.description: 1 while any menu page is open, 0 during normal gameplay.

menu_page_ids.description: Page ID constants — these are the primary values the menu state machine switches on. IDs are not contiguous and some are retail-debug hybrids.

save_slot_layout.description: Save/load menus present 8 save slots. Slot data is read from the UG/ directory in the game's user data path. Each slot renders: slot number, character name (from save header), money, current city, and timestamp.

map_screen.description: The full-map pause screen (MENUPAGE_MAP). Renders the radar texture at full resolution and overlays mission blips. The map uses the same tRadarTrace pool as the HUD minimap.

CMenuManager_Process.description: Per-frame menu state machine update — handles input, page transitions, and option callbacks

CMenuManager_DrawFrontEnd.description: Renders the current page using CFont and sprite quads

CMenuManager_ActivateGameMenu.description: Opens the pause menu from gameplay; sets m_bMenuActive and suspends game processing

CMenuManager_SwitchMenuOn.description: Alias / entry point used by FrontendBoot
